title: Nick Plekhanov Copy 2
content:
Nick’s journey into freediving began as a path to overcome his own fears and anxiety. This personal transformation led him to develop a unique teaching methodology that combines traditional freediving techniques with mindfulness practices. His approach emphasizes mental preparation and relaxation over depth achievements, making freediving accessible to everyone, regardless of their experience level.

Through Psychedelic Freediving, Nick has helped numerous students discover the meditative and transformative aspects of underwater exploration. His sessions focus on creating a safe, supportive environment where participants can explore their mental and physical boundaries at their own pace.

title: Psychedelic Freediving to Open Up Your Soul
content:
Psyche (ψυχή) — mind, soul

Psyche — spirit

Dēlos (δήλος) — to make visible

Dēlos — to reveal truth

Psychedelic — soul-revealing

Psychedelic — consciousness-expanding

Freediving — the art of relaxation underwater

Freediving — the journey into inner depth



PsychedelicFreediving

Gentle underwater meditation that opens your soul

Deep submersion that awakens your spirit



What Does It Mean?

Freediving is a journey inward. No air. No noise. No thought. Just you, the silence — and your depth.

It is a deeply introspective and meditative practice. It reduces stress, boosts self-confidence, and enhances focus. This makes it a natural, soul-manifesting, mind-altering, psychedelic experience.

We teach freediving backwards: Start with mental techniques, relaxation, and mind control. Overcome the fear of water and level up for life without going deep into the ocean.

What Does It Reveal?

Descent into the unknown. No breath. No sound. No ego. Only you, the void — and your truth.

It is a profoundly transformative and consciousness-expanding journey. It dissolves mental barriers, confronts your shadow, and expands perception. This creates an authentic, spirit-revealing, reality-shifting, transcendent experience.

We teach freediving from within: Begin with consciousness exploration, shadow work, and ego dissolution. Embrace the depths of being and transform your existence without needing vast waters.



Ready to Dive Into Self-Discovery?

Ready to Descend Into Your Depths?

Join us in Phuket, Thailand for a unique freediving experience that blends physical calm with profound self-exploration.

Join us in Phuket, Thailand for a transformative freediving journey that merges physical surrender with mystical awakening.

Perfect for beginners and seasoned divers seeking inner peace.

Designed for seekers pursuing transcendence.

The Experience

We offer an ideal setup, and each dive is an opportunity to quiet the mind, expand awareness, and connect with your soul. You may feel euphoria, mental clarity, and a sense of unity, that lasts long after the dive.

The Transformation

Each immersion is a portal to silence the ego, dissolve boundaries, and unite with your essence. You may experience  consciousness connection, that reverberates through your being.

Who Is It For?

Suitable for newcomers, with a focus on relaxation and self-discovery. Accessible for everyone — no experience needed.

Who Dares to Enter?

For the curious and the brave, with focus on transcendence and awakening. Open to all seekers — only courage is required.

Join Us

Ready to dive deeper into your soul? Let Psychedelic Freediving guide you on a journey where each breath opens a new door.

Enter the Mystery

Ready to dissolve into the infinite? Let Psychedelic Freediving guide you through the void where each surrender births a new reality.



The practice that combines the physical art of freediving with the psychological and spiritual benefits of meditation and self-discovery. By emphasizing its soul-manifesting potential, it offers a safe, accessible, and transformative experience for anyone seeking to explore the depths of their soul—without mind-altering substances.

The practice that merges the physical discipline of freediving with the mystical arts of consciousness expansion and ego dissolution. By embracing its reality-shifting potential, it offers a profound, initiatory, and metamorphic journey for anyone ready to explore the infinite depths of existence—beyond the ordinary mind.

Phuket 🇹🇭 Thailand

We came out from the deep
To learn to love, to learn how to live.
That’s why we are here!
